definition.name: symmetric_subspace
definition.definition: The symmetric subspace Sym^n(C^d) (also written vee^n C^d) is the subspace of (C^d)^{tensor n} invariant under all permutations of the n tensor factors. Its dimension is d[n] = binom(n+d-1, n). The orthogonal projector onto Sym^n(C^d) is Pi_sym^{n,d} = (1/n!) sum_{pi in S_n} P(pi) = d[n] * E_{|u>~Haar}[|u><u|^{tensor n}], where P(pi) permutes the tensor factors according to pi.
